title.narrative: Laying the Groundwork: A preparatory Between Venstres Ungdom and Orientame

description.narrative: VU Colombia was deeply inspired by meeting Orientame and sharing ideas. Their dedication and passion reinforced our motivation to build a strong, lasting partnership. Orientame�s commitment to reproductive rights and gender equality aligns with VU�s values, making them an ideal partner.We aim to strengthen youth engagement in reproductive rights advocacy and improve access to sexual and reproductive health information, empowering young women to make informed choices.To support this, we plan a preparatory study.This trip will strengthen our partnership and help develop a pilot project focused on youth engagement and gender equality, ensuring young people gain resources to advocate for their rights and actively participate in civil society.
